turns.prompt_text: where is a place where I can go to get my car lifted
turns.response_html:
Several auto body and mechanical shops in the area offer professional suspension and frame services suitable for vehicle modifications.

Shaffer's Auto Body and Mechanical Repair

  • Provides full mechanical repair services alongside body work, making them well-equipped for suspension adjustments.
  • Highly rated for transparency and thorough mechanical assessments.

Mike's Body & Frame

  • Specializes in frame and structural work, which is foundational for safe and effective lift kit installations.
  • Known for precision in alignment and structural integrity.

K2 Collision Center

  • Offers modern collision and structural repair technology with a high focus on technical accuracy.
  • Recommended by customers for professional communication and detailed project handling.
